title: Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center BIMS bimsDownload Servlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the bimsDownload servlet.
